context: A teacher mentors a student about handling failure
purpose: Teach: 堂々/気づく/防災/再会/新刊/特典/二度と/柔軟

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 先生、面接で頭が真っ白になって、二度と思い出したくないくらい失敗しました。
lines.en: Teacher, I went blank at the interview. I never want to remember it again.
lines.style: Defeated, slumping into the chair with embarrassment.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そう。でもまず、ちゃんと自分の弱さに気づくことができたのは大きな一歩よ。
lines.en: I see. But noticing your own weakness is already a big step forward.
lines.style: Warm, measured tone with a gentle reassuring smile.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 周りの学生はみんな堂々と話していて、自分だけ取り残された気がして…。
lines.en: Everyone around me spoke so confidently. I felt completely left behind.
lines.style: Voice trailing off, eyes lowered in shame.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 失敗は防災訓練と同じ。本番が来る前に、痛い経験をしておくものなの。
lines.en: Failure is like a disaster drill — pain practiced before the real thing.
lines.style: Calm teacher voice using a relatable metaphor.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: そういえば、図書館で先生の新刊を見ました。失敗論の本ですよね、特典のしおりも付いて。
lines.en: Oh, I saw your new book at the library — the one on failure, with the bookmark bonus.
lines.style: Brightening slightly, trying to change the mood.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: あら、読んでくれたの。あの本のテーマは、柔軟に考え直す勇気よ。
lines.en: Oh, you read it? The theme of that book is the courage to think flexibly.
lines.style: Pleasantly surprised, leaning forward with genuine interest now.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 柔軟に…。正直、もう面接官と再会するのが怖いです。
lines.en: Flexibly… honestly, I'm scared of facing that interviewer again.
lines.style: Quiet confession, fingers fidgeting nervously in lap.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 怖くていい。次に再会する時、今日の悔しさが必ずあなたを支えてくれるから。
lines.en: It's okay to be scared. Next time you meet them, today's regret will support you.
lines.style: Soft, encouraging, with quiet conviction in her voice.
